summary: The simulation is syntactically correct, runs, and implements a plausible agent-based mask adoption model with social influence, policy messaging, contexts, and a minimal supply chain. However, it does not fully implement the specified schema: several required entities (Location, PolicyMaker, InformationSource) and metrics are missing, parameter names diverge from the specification, and validation criteria are not implemented. Error handling and performance are generally reasonable, and the main() function is called at global scope as required.

issues.description: Missing explicit entities and behaviors as per spec: Location, PolicyMaker, and InformationSource classes with their attributes/behaviors are not implemented. The code uses modules (PolicyBroadcast, ContextScheduler) instead of the specified entity design.
issues.location: Entities section (no Location, PolicyMaker, InformationSource classes); modules PolicyBroadcast/ContextScheduler act as substitutes
issues.solution: Implement the specified classes (Location, PolicyMaker, InformationSource) with required attributes and behaviors. Wire them into the simulation loop to handle mandates, entry rules, observability, and targeted messaging.

issues.description: Required interactions/metrics are incomplete: no explicit policy enforcement actions or counts, no admission/rejection by locations, and no enforcement_actions_per_day metric.
issues.location: InfluenceAndAdoption._enforcement_signal and Simulation.run consumption logic; no enforcement events recorded
issues.solution: Add an enforcement mechanism at locations that triggers explicit actions (warnings/fines), track counts per day, and expose enforcement_actions_per_day in aggregator/history.

issues.description: Parameter schema diverges from the task specification (e.g., network_type, mandate_effect_strength, policy_start_day, policy_end_day, detection_probability, time_horizon_days).
issues.solution: Align parameter names and semantics with the spec or provide a mapping/adaptor so that inputs using the task's parameter schema are honored. Implement mandate start/end days and detection probability for enforcement.

issues.description: Metrics required by the spec are missing or only partially implemented: adoption_clustering, policy_effect_size (controlling for other factors), influence_attribution (share split across mechanisms), sustained_adoption_after_mandate_end, mask_shortage_days (only stockout rate is tracked), enforcement_actions_per_day.
issues.solution: Compute network assortativity/clustering of adopters, derive policy effect size via controlled counterfactuals, attribute adoptions by cause, compute sustained adoption post-mandate window, count stockout days explicitly, and track enforcement actions.

issues.description: Validation criteria from the spec are not implemented: adoption_convergence, supply_sanity_check, policy_monotonicity, no_policy_baseline_stability, optional calibration RMSE.
issues.location: No validation module; not in Simulation.evaluate or orchestrate()
issues.solution: Add a validation routine that computes these checks over the history and returns pass/fail flags and diagnostics. Integrate into orchestration and output.

issues.description: Mandate dynamics (policy_start_day/policy_end_day) are not modeled; enforcement level and policy effects are static, decoupled from explicit mandate periods.
issues.solution: Introduce time-based toggles for mandates and adjust enforcement/policy signals depending on policy_start_day/policy_end_day.

issues.description: Adoption inequality index is computed only by SES (range of group means), but the spec mentions disparity by demographic groups (e.g., political orientation).
issues.solution: Extend agent attributes (e.g., political_orientation) and compute inequality indices across multiple demographic partitions.

issues.description: Very broad exception handling (bare excepts) may mask legitimate errors during I/O and optional dependencies.
issues.location: Multiple functions: ensure_dir, seed_all, export_definitions, persist_used, save_results, save_all_io, visualize, load_ground_truth, calibrators
issues.solution: Narrow exception handling to specific exceptions where possible and log or include diagnostic messages to aid debugging.

issues.description: For large populations with high clustering_bias, triadic closure attempts scale with max(N, E) and could be slow; daily adjacency copying may also be costly.
issues.solution: Cap triadic closure attempts and consider incremental updates instead of copying full adjacency daily. Maintain adjacency as immutable baseline plus delta, or reduce frequency of rewiring.

issues.description: Some parameters appear duplicated or aliased (misinformation_fraction vs misinformation_rate), which could cause confusion.
issues.solution: Consolidate parameter naming and document aliases clearly. Prefer a single canonical parameter.
